name: highway-atlas
description: An interactive bilingual atlas of the North American highway network

scripts.fetch: node tools/fetch-source.mjs && node tools/fetch-fhwa.mjs && node tools/fetch-hpms.mjs
scripts.fetch:ca: node tools/fetch-canada.mjs && node tools/fetch-canada-nhs.mjs && node tools/fetch-canada-traffic.mjs
scripts.fetch:mx: node tools/fetch-mexico.mjs && node tools/fetch-mexico-traffic.mjs && node tools/fetch-mexico-designations.mjs
scripts.fetch:all: npm run fetch && npm run fetch:ca && npm run fetch:qc && npm run fetch:mx && npm run fetch:tw && npm run fetch:hk && npm run fetch:cn && npm run fetch:bridges && npm run fetch:borders && npm run fetch:tolls && npm run fetch:speed
scripts.build: node --max-old-space-size=16000 tools/build-data.mjs && node tools/build-names.mjs && node tools/build-towns.mjs && node tools/build-hk-traffic.mjs && node tools/build-crossings.mjs && node tools/build-bridges.mjs && node tools/build-tolls.mjs && node --max-old-space-size=8192 tools/build-speed.mjs && node tools/build-content.mjs && node tools/build-insights.mjs
scripts.docs: node tools/coverage-figures.mjs && node tools/build-insights.mjs && node tools/build-docs.mjs
scripts.test: node tools/check-i18n.mjs && node tools/build-content.mjs && node tools/check-data.mjs && node tools/readme-figures.mjs && node tools/coverage-figures.mjs && node tools/build-insights.mjs && node tools/build-docs.mjs
